sentences.text: Jeanine Ferris Pirro -LRB- born June 2 , 1951 -RRB- is a former judge and District Attorney from the state of New York .	District Attorney	District Attorney	state	U.S. state	New York	New York (state)

Pirro hosts Fox News Channel 's television program Justice with Judge Jeanine and contributes on other Fox News programs and NBC 's Today .	Justice with Judge Jeanine	Justice with Judge Jeanine	Fox News	Fox News	NBC	NBC

A Republican from Chemung County , New York , Pirro was the first female judge on the Westchester County Court bench before being elected the first female district attorney of Westchester County , serving for 12 years .	Westchester County	Westchester County, New York	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	New York	New York (state)	district attorney	district attorney
As DA Pirro gained considerable visibility in cases regarding domestic abuse and crimes against the elderly .
Pirro was the Republican nominee for New York Attorney General in 2006 .	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	New York	New York (state)	New York Attorney General	New York Attorney General
